description: Land Acquisition - Gangodawila, Sri Jayewardenepura-Kotte D/S Division, Colombo District - Amendment to the notice published in Gaz. Ex. Ord. No. 1941/20 of 19.11.2015 by Tangalle D/S Division
categorisation: This gazette content is exclusively about land acquisition notices under the Land Acquisition Act, detailing specific parcels of land being acquired by the government for public purposes. It contains detailed descriptions of individual land lots, their locations, extents, and claimants, which falls squarely under the "Land and property-related matters" category for Type 4 (Land Gazettes).
